summary: Parsing malformed input containing <> passes an empty buffer to Reader::read_start. The parent implementation evaluates buf[len - 1], causing subtraction overflow in debug builds or an out-of-bounds panic without overflow checks. The fix uses buf.last(), safely skipping the trailing-slash branch for an empty buffer. The fix adds the root-level integration test fuzz_53 in tests/test.rs, which exercises this input. No tests were executed during planning.
